completion_note: Research complete with a shortfall: 9 observed successes, 6 selected targets and 3 reserves; 4 selected targets short of ten.

market.summary: Nepal combines national/public heritage collections, university and independently managed campus libraries, special research libraries, and community libraries. Koha is a strong reuse opportunity in observed KU, LBU, Keshar and Thapathali deployments. PMB is also concretely observed at DKRML, CEHRD, AFU Forestry and Alliance Française. These selected endpoints do not estimate national LMS market share. Pokhara uses Mumolas, and Prithvi Narayan exposes a different custom catalogue. Physical books, digital repositories and licensed journals must remain separate.
market.platform_strategy: Start with Koha across the four verified independent institutions/networks. Add a session-aware PMB public-form adapter to unlock DKRML plus three reserve collections; existing pinned PMB support is not assumed universal. Build a separate public POST/JSON adapter for Prithvi Narayan. Keep NNL/TUCL/SSB and major government PMB collections as recovery priorities; do not infer absence from blocked checks.
